effects.display_name: Ender Golem awake and deactivation prerequisites
effects.actual_behavior: Synced IS_AWAKEN defaults false; its Boolean setter only writes the accessor and does not heal, reset timers, or change animations. After parent tick, deactivateProgress rises by 1 while dormant and <30, or falls by 1 while awake and >0. The later tick attack-dispatch block requires exactly zero progress and isAlive; payloads/selection are deferred. These progress updates have no local side/NoAI/alive gate. At the end of server tick, timeWithoutTarget increments. Any non-null target resets it and awakens a dormant entity without an explicit target-alive check. Strictly >400 targetless ticks while awake reset the timer and set awake false; no local NoAI/alive gate is added. Native HurtByTarget and Player/IronGolem NearestAttackableTarget registrations supply targets; original native goal admission remains. No separate concrete HP phase/shield/armor-state setter is declared. Animation-dependent reduction is separate from this Boolean; animation offense stays R2k11b.

effects.display_name: Ender Golem incoming reductions and admission order
effects.actual_behavior: Before shared admission: if (animation==VOID_RUNE_ATTACK OR !isAwaken) AND (source has BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY OR source is not exact minecraft:magic), narrow float(double(amount)*0.5). Thus the bypass tag enables this reduction even for magic; untagged exact magic skips it. Then calculateRange(source) reads the causing entity, but this concrete local result is unused. Read getDirectEntity; AbstractGolem direct actors independently narrow float(double(amount)*0.5), even for bypass-tagged or magic sources. The two reductions can stack and are not flattened into one operation. Call LLibrary_Boss_Monster.hurt once with the same DamageSource and transformed float. Concrete code never returns early, awakens directly, or adds a post-hurt callback. Inherited virtual invulnerability, bypass/cap/range/bucket, native defenses and hurt-return rollback/regeneration bookkeeping remain in their locked order.

effects.display_name: Guardian staged bullet motion, damage and Levitation
effects.actual_behavior: Both uppercut goals call Bulletpattern; with target at animationTick54 it creates9 owned bullets (i=-4..4), staging near floored target X/Z at targetY+0.1 (minus1 only if airborne, not in water and unsupported). Cardinal direction comes from boss/target block X/Z. Native delay30 stages velocity=(start-current)/remainingTimer; when timer<=0 first sets fired=true, velocity0 and timer30. Fired server ticks add dir*0.1 only while velocity²<=16; later timeout discards. It overrides tick without super.tick and uses move-vector collision, inherited canHitEntity and posted/cancellable projectile impact. Unfired impacts do not deliver payload/discard. Fired server entity hit requests mobProjectile6; hurt=true alone invokes enchantment post-attack effects then adds literal LEVITATION100/0 to LivingEntity with no explicit effect source. Fired impact discards regardless of hurt/effect success. Fired hurt callback server-discard returns true; unfired hurt returns true without discard; canBeCollidedWith=false.

effects.display_name: Guardian death callback and native respawner linkage
effects.actual_behavior: Reuses shared cancelled/credited death callback admission. Guardian getDeathAnimation returns FALLEN196; shared LLibrary duration is196-20=176. onDeathAIUpdate calls super then zeroes horizontal motion retaining Y. AfterDefeatBoss with configured respawner=true, server, existing home and resolvable home dimension invokes Respawner at home X/Z with searchY homeY..homeY-10. Native code reads support/collision from current boss level but writes target home level; places BOSS_RESPAWNER with update flag2 even if no support (fallback maxY). Stores ENDER_GUARDIAN type and VOID_EYE requirement. Matching native item use lights block/consumes1; nearby alive player radius9, LIT, nonpeaceful server and animation counter>=19 attempt spawn. Native spawn finalizes SPAWNER and sets home; destroys respawner only on successful addFreshEntity. It does not call setUsedMassDestruction(false), so fresh Guardian retains the locked used=true default unlike altar spawn.

effects.display_name: Guardian vortex pull and terminal native explosion
effects.actual_behavior: BLACKHOLE goal tick26 with target searches sturdy support under target X/Z between min(targetY,bossY) and max+1; on support creates Guardian-owned Void_Vortex lifespan300. Native tick, without local side guard, pulls while min(tickCount,currentLifespan)>=16 in AABB X/Z ±3,Y[0,15]. Exclude vortex allies, current cached owner/owner allies and Player invulnerable ability; velocity += (0,-2,0)-normalize(recipientPos-vortexPos)*0.075. Server tick directly reads owner and does not call getOwner; after ordinary load it may remain null, changing pull exclusions and explosion actors/type to ownerless explosion.

effects.actual_behavior: Concrete tick decrements positive native cooldowns once, then unconditionally draws nextInt(3) for the poke choice. Locked phase/shield transition priority precedes offense. effects.display_name: Ignis offensive motion and animation chains
effects.actual_behavior: Priority1 offensive goals claim MOVE/JUMP/LOOK; idle AttackMoveGoal priority2 pursues but has no melee/damage call. Body-check normal writes target displacement*.25 at20, soul*.4F at16, Y0. Air smash writes target XZ displacement*.15,Y1.3 at19 (no target Y1.4) then onGround after19 ->SMASH. Reinforced variants do the same at84 (no target Y1.8), land after84 -> matching normal/soul smash. Horizontal/poke goals add forward*.3*clamped distance (clamps10/15; poke no-target adds unit forward); combo1 adds forward*.35*clamp(distance,0,5) at15/36/71, then target-nonnull at84 ->COMBO2. Predictive uppercut/combo2 snapshot initial targetXZ; before charge27 compute floor(currentXZ+(currentXZ-initialXZ)/27*12), then at27 write displacement*.3F,Y0 and clear target vector; stop also clears it. Uppercut retains target captured at goal start; combo2 rereads current target. Small swings/combo2 add forward1.5 at native ticks, subject to target-distance>3.5 where specified. Forced facing/zeroXZ preserve native windows. Before selection, floatStrider native lava support may setOnGround(true), feeding the air-smash landing gate; otherwise velocity is halved plus randomFloat*.5Y. Native canStandOnFluid accepts lava, with fluid affected/push overrides false. tick also calls the locked native repelEntities(1.4F,4F,1.4F,1.4F); its helper and native target pushes are reused, not new damage.

effects.actual_behavior: IgnisExplosion preserves native Explosion subclass construction, native DamageSources.explosion(this), default EntityBasedExplosionDamageCalculator for nonnull source (else default calculator). explode performs native ray/block resistance collection, query excluding the supplied direct source, mutable NeoForge onExplosionDetonate list, ignoreExplosion and distance<=2*radius/nonzero eye-direction gates. Neither hurttrue nor shouldDamageEntity gates the motion callback. All reviewed callers pass KEEP, so finalize skips block destruction; firetrue still independently places native BaseFireBlock at eligible air-over-solid collected blocks with nextInt(3)==0, with no extra griefing check. Terminal Flame Strike firefalse skips fire placement.

effects.display_name: Abyss altar sacrifice, clearance, native spawn/home and inventory persistence
effects.actual_behavior: Altar useItemOn, without local server guard, accepts a non-shifting Player held item other than the altar block item; empty slot receives a copy count1 and noncreative inventory shrinks1. Occupied slot ejects its copy and clears instead; placement itself is not restricted to a sacrifice. Native block tick has no side gate. tick tests nonempty slot0 exact ABYSSAL_SACRIFICE, then summoningticks>121 first calls BlockBreaking(3,6,3) and EntityType.create(level), both before ServerLevel/non-null spawn guard. Clearance scans floor(float(blockPos)) + XZ[-3,3], Y[0,6]; skips the exact default AIR state reference and ALTAR_DESTROY_IMMUNE, then native destroyBlock(pos,false) with no explicit actor/grief/destroy hook/side gate here. The pinned tag protects the altar itself. Server spawn sets XZ float(pos)+.5/Y+3 and current-dimension altar GlobalPos home, then addFreshEntity. Only true add empties sacrifice, marks changed and notifies; no explicit finalizeSpawn, persistence flag, phase setter, water test or altar removal. Failed add keeps item/counter and retries on later eligible ticks. Counter updates after this branch: !summoning resets0, otherwise increments; cleared item is noticed next tick. Native inventory NBT load/save only; countdown/summoning/chomp state unsaved. Waterlogged block defaultfalse/placement tests vanilla WATER, not a summoning prerequisite; altar water state is distinct from Leviathan eye-fluid admission.

effects.actual_behavior: Concrete addAdditionalSaveData calls parent then stores RageMeter via putInt and Tombstone_Direction via putByte((byte)get3DDataValue()). Read calls parent, then unconditional getByte -> Direction.from3DDataValue -> raw setTombstoneDirection, followed by getInt -> raw setRageMeter. Missing RageMeter defaults0; missing direction byte defaults0 and is passed to the native direction conversion rather than preserving the synced NORTH/finalized SOUTH. Weapon, flying, attack state, rageTicks, destroyBlocksTick, combo/grab and attack cooldowns are not serialized by these concrete methods. Fresh defaults and later tick/native goals apply on reload; no synthetic resume state or clamped rage is added. Inherited Home/LifeRemain and unsaved homeTicks/self_regen/request bucket retain their locked semantics.

Arrow and halberd producers snapshot different coefficients (.05F/.1F) instead of DMG; locked native decay/persistence remain unchanged.

effects.display_name: Cursed tombstone Maledictus activation, spawn/home and native retry prerequisites
effects.actual_behavior: Cursed_Tombstone_Block defaults FACING=NORTH/LIT=false/POWERED=false. Its native ticker connects the exact Cursed_tombstone_Entity.commonTick on both sides. While unpowered, cooldownProgress increments until installed CursedTombstoneCooldown1*1200, then a later tick sets POWERED=true. useItemOn requires POWERED AND !LIT, writes LITtrue and returnsSUCCESS; it neither tests nor consumes a specific item and has no local side guard. Powered+lit increments tickCount; tickCount>63 creates native MALEDICTUS before checking ServerLevel/non-null. Server spawn sets position(x+.5,y+2,z+.5), writes block FACING, sets Home=current dimension/tombstone pos, then finalizeSpawn(SPAWNER) overwrites directionSOUTH and initializes shared homeTicks400. It clears offsets X/Z=-1..1,Y=0..5 before addFreshEntity, skipping AIR.defaultBlockState and cataclysm:altar_destroy_immune, using destroyBlock(false) with no local mobGriefing gate. Only addFreshEntity=true triggers final tombstone destroyBlock(false). No attack state, persistence-required flag or target write is added. The branch does not reset tickCount after a failed create/add; if the lit tombstone remains, later eligible ticks retry. Powered+unlit resets tickCount0. Block entity saves only cooldownProgress with putInt; load tests contains("summonCooldownProgress",11) then getInt, so the ordinary saved int does not round-trip through that exact-type admission. tickCount is unsaved. Existing block state persistence and native creation/finalization/add/block hooks remain native.

effects.display_name: Monstrosity native offensive AI sequence
effects.actual_behavior: Priority3 attack goals bind state0->3 smash,6 magma,10 flare,7 absorption,8 shoulder,9 overpower and end at0; priority5 InternalMoveGoal pursues rather than delivering a melee hurt itself. Base attack canUse requires alive nonnull target, strict distance<range and state0; start sets attack state/stops navigation; continue requires active state and ticks<=max. Facing tracks before lookTick, then holds old yaw. Goals are noninterruptible and update every tick; native flags/scheduler remain.

Base attack canUse requires alive nonnull target, strict distance<range and state0; start sets attack state/stops navigation; continue requires active state and ticks<=max. effects.vanilla_differences: Magma adds distance>=14,16%/LOS/magazine<installed15/cooldown<=0; flare adds distance>=10,18%/LOS/cooldown<=0; shoulder adds distance>=5.75,12%/LOS/cooldown<=0. None adds a berserk or awake predicate. Smash adds32%; overpower adds40% and cooldown<=0. Absorption overrides canUse: target alive,state0,isInLava,magazine>=15; it does NOT call base range admission (registered1 is unused here). Magma stop increments magazine and sets240 even if no shot occurred; flare/charge/overpower stop set120/80/160. Positive cooldowns decrement each concrete tick on both sides, even NoAI; reload starts private cooldown defaults0 while magazine persistence is locked R2k4a.

effects.display_name: Ancient Remnant native offensive goal selection
effects.actual_behavior: Offense is selected by native GoalSelector, not a new aiStep selector. Priority3 registers bite, stomp, roar, monolith, charge preparation, tail slam and tail swing in that order; priority2 charge-run and priority1 crash-recovery use InternalStateGoal. Ordinary attack admission reuses live target/distance/start-state, then nextFloat()*100<configured roll and MELEE mode; roar adds cooldown, tail slam grounded/cooldown, tail swing targetY<bossY+1. effects.display_name: Ancient Remnant idle/charge block destruction and debris
effects.actual_behavior: Concrete tick server/state0 calls ChargeBlockBreaking(.5); server Charge calls1.5, each using installed ignoreMobGriefing=true OR canEntityGrief(level,boss). No local NoAI/necklace/POWER/hit-result gate added to these callsites. Helper scans bbox.inflate(inflate,.2,inflate) from floor(minX),floor(bossY),floor(minZ) to bbox maxima. Each nonair cell requires canEntityDestroy, !REMNANT_IMMUNE and onEntityDestroyBlock. nextInt(6)==0 and !hasBlockEntity branch constructs locked debris life20 from current blockState, destroys(false,boss), adds custom velocity based on boss-minus-debris with XZ(-1.2+random)/3 and Y.2+Gaussian*.15, then adds entity. Else destroys(false,boss) directly. Native destroy return is ORed into local flag but never read, and does not gate debris addition or charge hurt. Debris creates neither extra hurt nor terrain placement. Stomp/monolith sampling stays separate and does not use this destruction helper.

effects.display_name: Scylla Ceraunus normal return and native hook distinction
effects.actual_behavior: Anchor tick after parent resolves controller. Only Scylla controller syncs controllerID and boss AnchorUUID.
